title: Origin story: Sun Wukong
description: Sun Wukong was born from a stone egg on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, and became king of the monkeys by braving the waterfall curtain. He studied under a Taoist master, stole the dragon king's iron staff, erased his name from the book of death, and rebelled against heaven itself before being set to guard the monk Xuanzang on the Journey to the West.

title: Ability profile: Sun Wukong
description: Ranked abilities: Combat — rank 100/100; Transformation (72 forms) — rank 99/100; Speed (cloud-somersault) — rank 98/100; Cunning — rank 97/100; Loyalty — rank 96/100.

title: Power ranking: Sun Wukong
description: Powers: The Ruyi staff, weighing 13,500 jin, shrinking to a needle; Seventy-two transformations; Eyes that see through all disguise.

title: Stamina feats: Sun Wukong
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Survived Laozi's furnace for forty-nine days; Fought heaven's armies single-handed.

title: Crossover notes: Sun Wukong
description: Sun Wukong crosses naturally with: rebellion, transformation, loyalty, strength.

title: Cultural impact: Sun Wukong
description: The most beloved trickster-hero of East Asia; rebellion redeemed by loyalty.

title: Generator record: Sun Wukong
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Sun Wukong's database.
